content:
**Fail-closed on unreadable brain.config.json across four secret-scan readers (#712)**

collect.mjs, engram.mjs, plainfiles.mjs, and lane-scrub.mjs each had their own catch { return {} } around the brain.config.json read feeding governance.memorySecretPatterns/memorySecretAllowPatterns. An unreadable-but-present config silently reverted the scan to DEFAULT_SECRET_PATTERNS and reported clean. Replaced all four with loadBrainConfigOrThrow(root): ENOENT still returns {} (absence stays green), any other read/parse failure now propagates through each call site's existing error handling (exit 1 for the three memory write ops, exit 2 uncomputable for lane-scrub). Mutation-table proof: reverting any one reader to the old catch shape makes exactly one named test fail, nothing else regresses.
source: engram save on gandalf-ROG-Zephyrus-G15-GA503QR-GA503QR; actor from git config brain.actor; actorKind agent from env AI_AGENT=claude-code_2-1-266_agent; issue 712 declared via --issue
